opportunities.title: Small grants

deadlines.raw: 31 March for a decision in May

amount.raw: Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Our small grants are awarded as ‘seed funding’ with the aim of enabling projects that might otherwise not be possible without our support. Awards vary according to project but will only exceptionally exceed £6,000 and will generally fall in a range of £1,500-£5,000. We therefore encourage applications that are seeking or have secured other sources of funding.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in Medicine and Health

deadlines.raw: 1 December, for a decision in March of the following year

amount.raw: Up to £10,000 for one-year projects, up to £30,000 for multi-year projects.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference will be given to those who have not previously been involved in UK-Japan collaboration, and applications from those in the early stages of their career are particularly welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Butterfield Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. They are intended to be broad in application and can also support the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
